changeSet.author: devops
changeSet.comment: Create advisor_log table for ask-mode Q&A exchanges
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE advisor_log ( id BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY, campaign_id BIGINT NOT NULL, turn_number INT NOT NULL, user_message TEXT NOT NULL, advisor_response TEXT NOT NULL, created TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), CONSTRAINT pk_advisor_log PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT fk_advisor_log_campaign FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id) REFERENCES campaign (character_id) ON DELETE CASCADE ); CREATE INDEX idx_advisor_log_campaign_id ON advisor_log (campaign_id);
